item.description:
We have resolved the issue and transactions are now being synced correctly. In the vast majority of cases, previously missing transactions will show up automatically in the next 24 hours.
In a few rare cases, additional action may be required and we will reach out directly. If you do not see expected transactions please monitor your inbox, or reach out to our support team for further assistance.
